question: What is the title of the first poetry collection by Nissim Ezekiel, one of the most celebrated poets in Indian English Literature?
solution:
The correct answer is __**A Time of Change**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Nissim Ezekiel** was a pioneering figure in Indian English Literature and is regarded as one of the foundational poets of modern Indian English poetry.
 
• His first poetry collection, **"A Time of Change,"** was published in **1952**, marking the beginning of his illustrious literary career.
 
• The collection reflects Ezekiel's early poetic style, characterized by introspection, philosophical musings, and a distinct modernist approach.
 
• Ezekiel's work is known for its themes of identity, alienation, and the complexities of human relationships, which are evident in this debut collection.
 
• "A Time of Change" helped establish Ezekiel as a prominent voice in Indian English poetry and paved the way for his subsequent contributions to the literary world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Modern Indian English Poetry:**

 
 
• Modern Indian English poetry emerged during the mid-20th century, blending traditional Indian themes with Western literary techniques.
 
• Nissim Ezekiel, along with poets like Kamala Das and A.K. Ramanujan, played a pivotal role in shaping this literary movement.
 
 
 
• **Key Themes in Ezekiel's Poetry:**
 
 
• His poetry often explores themes like self-discovery, urban life, existential dilemmas, and cultural identity.
 
• Ezekiel's work is celebrated for its linguistic precision and ability to capture the nuances of everyday life.
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Works by Ezekiel:**
 
 
• Some of his other celebrated poetry collections include **"The Unfinished Man" (1960)** and **"The Exact Name" (1965).**
 
• He is also known for his poem **"Night of the Scorpion,"** a quintessential piece reflecting Indian rural life and familial bonds.
 
 
 
• **Legacy:**
 
 
• Ezekiel was awarded the **Sahitya Akademi Award** in 1983 for his collection "Latter-Day Psalms."
 
• He remains one of the most influential figures in Indian English Literature, inspiring generations of poets and writers.
